title: policy_stream_status
description:
Robot -> client. Reply to a policy_stream verb.

`ok` defaults to FALSE when absent: a partial or malformed reply must not read as success.

NOTE on liveness: there is no unsolicited death notification. The L2 streamer is a ZMQ REP socket -- it can only answer a request -- and its internal end-of-run result is discarded rather than pushed. A stream that dies mid-run (sink timeout, camera silence) is only observable by POLLING with action "status". Do not build a UI that waits for a failure frame that never arrives.
